outcome: Cost of preeclampsia from the perspective of the reimbursement institution
cohort: 65 patients diagnosed with preeclampsia in 2021 at a single institution
finding: The study found that the average cost of preeclampsia from the perspective of the reimbursement institution varied depending on the severity of preeclampsia and mode of delivery, ranging from 5331.67 L ($659.86) for mild preeclampsia with cesarean section to 8487.48 L (1050.43 $) for severe preeclampsia with vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The cost of preeclampsia was higher for patients who had a cesarean section compared to those who had a vaginal delivery, both in the severe and mild preeclampsia groups.
